items.title: Forge: friendly merge errors (no raw xelib/EPERM dumps) + cleanup hardening
items.why: a real tester saw a raw 'EPERM … Loader failed' dump on the Forge's plugin list instead of a nice message — the worker's raw stderr leaks straight to the UI; also harden the non-fatal sandbox cleanup (their C:-drive Steam install invites Defender file locks).
items.prompt: Read vortex-tools/vortex-collection-tools/design/BUILD-PROMPT-merge-error-handling.md and build it. A tester saw a raw EPERM sandbox-cleanup warning + xelib 'Loader failed' verbatim on the Forge instead of a friendly error. (1) Tag the removeSandbox cleanup warning `##WARN## ` in merge-worker.js and have merge-runner.js SKIP those lines like it already skips `##PROGRESS## ` — the non-fatal cleanup warning must NEVER reach the user. (2) Mark ONLY the worker's own intentional friendly errors with a `##USERERR## ` prefix; in merge-runner.js surface those verbatim and fall back to the existing CRASH_HELP_TEXT for ALL other stderr (native xelib errors, unmarked crashes) — defensive by default; keep raw text in a console.error. (3) Harden removeSandbox: maxRetries 5→10, retryDelay 200→300, and best-effort-sweep leftover .vct-merge-tmp/vct-merge-* dirs on the next run. Use the EXISTING CRASH_HELP_TEXT copy (design-owned) — don't invent new user-facing text; flag in the handoff if a case genuinely needs its own message. Verify + handoff.

items.title: ESLifier awareness — Settings path + Missing Masters downgrade
items.why: kills the false-positive 'missing master' when ESLifier deliberately swapped a file
items.prompt: Read vortex-tools/vortex-collection-tools/design/BUILD-PROMPT-eslifier-filter.md and build it. CRITICAL: verify the detection against a real ESLifier output folder + a live Missing Masters scan FIRST (disabled-count lesson) — don't ship a guessed trace. v1 = Settings ESLifier output-folder path + Nexus helper link, and the Missing Masters ON-by-default toggle that downgrades ESLifier-traced files from critical to warning (surfaced, not hidden). Update config.example.json for both new fields. Handoff with what the real ESLifier→Vortex deploy actually looked like and which scan signal the false positive fired on.

items.title: Clear stale end-of-flow banner on Preview re-arm
items.prompt: In Update Collection: re-doing Apply Ignores via Preview doesn't clear the stale end-of-flow completion banner until Apply re-succeeds. Wire callout-clearing into the Preview re-arm so the banner clears the moment the step is re-armed. Pre-existing minor issue; not blocking.

items.title: Rebuilding mods… needs an X-of-X counter and a % complete indicator
items.why: Backing up and downloading both show live '(index/total)' progress, but Rebuilding is the one phase that just sits static the whole time with no sense of how far along it is.
items.prompt:
Real gap, confirmed by reading the actual code (not guessed): the 'Rebuilding mods…' phase (web/public/app.js's PHASE_TEXT.rebuilding) is the ONLY phase with no live progress detail — 'Backing up' and 'Downloading missing' both already show '(index/total): modName' via their own backup-progress/download-progress events (setPhase calls in handleRunEvent), but rebuilding just sits static the whole time. Per-mod mod-start/mod-complete events DO already exist and update each mod's own table row (lib/collection-runner.js's runRebuild onModStart/onModComplete, wired in web/rebuild-routes.js ~line 621-635) — they just carry no index/total, and nothing aggregates them into an overall counter.

GOAL (director's ask): show 'X out of X mods rebuilt' and a % complete indicator while rebuilding is in progress.

BACKEND (web/rebuild-routes.js): runRebuild's onModComplete callback already fires once per finished mod, in completion order (not necessarily start order, since concurrency can be >1) — track a running completedCount there (starts at 0, increments each call) and include it plus rebuildQueue.length as `completed`/`total` fields on the existing `mod-complete` SSE emit. Don't add a new event type — extend the existing one, matching how mod-complete already carries the full result entry.

FRONTEND (web/public/app.js): in the `case 'mod-complete':` handler (~line 1096), after the existing per-row update, call setPhase() with a new persistent progress string — 'Rebuilding mods… (X of Y — Z%)', computed from the new completed/total fields (Math.round(completed/total*100) for the percentage). This REPLACES the static 'Rebuilding mods…' phase text with a live-updating one, same spirit as backup-progress/download-progress's own setPhase calls right above it. Keep the per-mod-row status updates exactly as they are — this is purely an ADDITIONAL aggregate summary line, not a replacement for the per-row detail.

Check DESIGN.md for whether phase-indicator text has any established formatting convention (percentage display, parenthetical style) to match — don't invent new formatting if one already exists for the sibling phases.

VERIFY: a real rebuild run (multiple mods, concurrency both 1 and >1 if easy to test) showing the counter/percentage advance correctly and landing on the true total at completion. Handoff with what you tested.
